Rina (Design): Quick sync: I'm iterating on the invite flowroles matrix to address long pages for orgs with 40+ roles. Trying a compact grid with selectable chips and a tiny SSO indicator per role. Screenshot: https://redwood.design/s/compact-invite-v1.png :camera:

Noah (Frontend): Compact feels better for dense orgs. Two immediate engineering notes: keep chips >=32px touch target, and avoid moving focus when chips wrap. I'll implement focus-visible styles and ensure tabindex ordering stays linear.

Aisha (A11y): Accessibility: chips must have clear accessible names and visible focus rings. Tooltips for SSO status aren't enough; tooltips need a keyboard-accessible trigger. Prefer an info button next to the pill that opens a small dialog (role="dialog") with the explanation. Also, color contrast for light badges fails AA, please use darker fill or border.

Priya (PM): Product requirement: org-level SSO cannot be overridden. When org enforcement is on, per-role SSO toggles should be disabled with clear copy. We want analytics: invite_flow_open, roles_filter_used, sso_info_opened. Keep CTA simple: 'Invite' with a short microcopy beneath if SSO applies.

Rina (Design): Good calls. I'll change the pill to a darker filled style and add an inline 'i' button that opens a small modal for the SSO note. Microcopy under CTA: 'SSO will be required for invited users.' Short and scannable.

Noah (Frontend): Will add aria-describedby from submit button to that microcopy and ensure Esc closes the modal. Also adding unit tests for focus landing when modal opens.

Aisha (A11y): Please test with NVDA and VoiceOver. Ensure the modal traps focus and that focus returns to the invite button on close. Also make sure any status changes announced via aria-live.

Design Bot: preview:compact-invite built  https://staging.redwood/preview/compact-invite (sha: gh789) :white_check_mark:

Noah (Frontend): Ran axe: 1) missing aria-label on chip remove buttons, 2) contrast on helper text, 3) dialog close button missing aria-label. I'll fix these in the branch.

Rina (Design): I'll update Figma frames and include alt text for screenshots for the PR. Will shorten helper text to one line so it's not noisy.

Priya (PM): Timeline: target next sprint as long as a11y issues are resolved. If not, we'll delay. Thanks everyone.
